quandoUsar: Top navigation for a product or documentation site: brand, a few sections, “Sign in,” and a primary action, fixed at the top and opaque on scroll.
Sections with many destinations that call for mega menu panels with a description per link and a featured card (`variant="mega"`).
Sites that need to work on mobile: below 760 px of header width, the links fold into a menu sheet.
quandoEvitar: Use `page-header` for the header of a page inside the app, with project title, tabs, and actions.
Use `animated-sidebar` when the app's navigation is a side menu with groups and many sections.
Use `drawer` when the mobile menu needs to be a modal dialog: the sheet here does not trap focus.

teclado.acao: Move focus between the top-level items, wrapping around; with a panel open, the panel follows the item.
On an item with a panel, opens the panel and moves focus to the first link.
Inside the panel, move between links; `↑` on the first link closes the panel and returns focus to the item.
Inside the panel, go to the first or last link.
Closes the panel and returns focus to the item; with the mobile sheet open, closes the sheet and returns focus to the menu button.
On an item with a panel, open or close the panel; on the menu button, open or close the sheet.

acessibilidade: The top-level links sit in a `<nav>` named by `label` (“Main”); simple items receive `aria-current="page"`, but on an item with a panel the current state is only visual.
Panel triggers have `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, the panel is a `role="region"` with the item's name, and the outgoing face is `inert` during the switch.
The menu button has `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, and a label that toggles; the sheet neither moves nor traps focus on open, and `Esc` closes it, returning focus to the button.
movimento: Past `scrollThreshold` (8 px), the background becomes opaque with a border and shadow and only lightens again near the top; the hover highlight (outside `centered`) and the current-section indicator slide between links.
The panel opens after 70 ms of mouse intent, the height follows the content on a spring that does not overshoot and, when moving to another item, the content enters from the side you moved toward.
The mobile sheet drops from the bar opening its height on a spring, with rows in sequence; with “reduce motion” on, panel and sheet only fade and the menu icon does not rotate.
responsivo: The header is its own container: below 760 px the links, the secondary action, and the panel disappear, the menu button appears, and widening again closes the sheet.
The sheet scrolls inside up to `--site-header-sheet-max` (default `100dvh - 65px`); set that variable when the header lives in a fixed-height container.
desempenho: Listens to `scroll` passively on the window or on `scrollContainer` and uses a `ResizeObserver` on the header; hover intent timers are cleared on unmount.
notasIA: Import the named component `SiteHeader`; the default export is `SiteHeaderBlock`, the preview with layout switching inside a scrolling page.
If the page scrolls inside an element, pass it as `scrollContainer`: it decides when the background becomes opaque and receives `overflow: hidden` while the mobile sheet is open.

Items with `links` only become a panel in `mega`; since the click event does not reach `onNavigate`, for client-side routing leave the destinations without `href` (they become buttons) and navigate in the callback.
